mapper.select:
SELECT P.POST_ID, P.USER_ID, P.TITLE, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, P.IS_BLOCK FROM POST P WHERE P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE
ORDER BY P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC
ORDER BY ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE PL WHERE PL.POST_ID = P.POST_ID ) DESC, P.POST_ID DESC
ORDER BY P.POST_ID DESC
SELECT P.POST_ID, P.USER_ID, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, P.IS_BLOCK, P.TRANSPORT_COST, P.FOOD_COST, P.OTHER_COST FROM POST P WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId} AND P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST ( USER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATE_AT, IS_BLOCK, TRANSPORT_COST, FOOD_COST, OTHER_COST ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, now(), FALSE, #{transportCost}, #{foodCost}, #{otherCost} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, TRANSPORT_COST = #{transportCost}, FOOD_COST = #{foodCost}, OTHER_COST = #{otherCost} WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.select:
SELECT P.POST_ID, P.USER_ID, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.CREATE_AT, P.IS_BLOCK, ( SELECT IU.UPLOAD_PATH FROM POST_UPLOAD PU JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON IU.UPLOAD_ID = PU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE PU.POST_ID = P.POST_ID ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH FROM POST P WHERE P.IS_BLOCK = FALSE
ORDER BY P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC
ORDER BY P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC
ORDER BY P.POST_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST WHERE IS_BLOCK = FALSE

SELECT IU.UPLOAD_ID, PU.POST_ID, IU.ORIGIN_NAME, IU.UPLOAD_PATH, IU.IMAGE_ORDER FROM POST_UPLOAD PU JOIN IMAGE_UPLOAD IU ON IU.UPLOAD_ID = PU.UPLOAD_ID WHERE PU.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY IU.IMAGE_ORDER ASC
